h: Up in the town by the station
p: Station Avenue is up at the top of Filey, so Superslots is the first stop for anyone stepping off the train on the Yorkshire Coast line between Hull and Scarborough. Like most seaside arcades, it has a family side and a separate 18+ area for the cash-prize machines, so check the signs as you go in.

From here, the main shopping streets of Murray Street and Belle Vue Street are only a few minutes' walk, with bakeries, butchers and cafés that keep plenty of local trade going all year. Head down through the town and you'll reach the Crescent Gardens and the sea. St Oswald's Church, an old stone church in a lovely spot above the ravine, is worth a look if you like a bit of history.
